page_title: NOT 1-1 CRY | Nottingham Forest v Crystal Palace 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+4' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tyrick Mitchell trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace).
90+2' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dean Henderson leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham).
87' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
87' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
84' Ola Aina is substituted due to injury. Nuno Espirito Santo gives a chance to Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).
83' Ola Aina (Nottingham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
83' The game is interrupted. Ola Aina (Nottingham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
82' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adam Wharton as he is replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
74' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
74' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
70' The foul by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Chris Kavanagh.

69' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Matz Sels shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
68' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

68' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace). The ball goes out for a corner. Crystal Palace can continue in their attacking effort.
66' Here is a change. Jordan Ayew is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
63' The ball possession at the moment is 58:42.

61' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Morgan Gibbs-White and scores magnificently from close range into the roof of the net. 1:1.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Divock Origi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham).
58' A cross into the box from Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nottingham.
58' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Chris Wood (Nottingham) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
56' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
55' The game is interrupted now, Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
49' A yellow card for a tackle by Felipe (Nottingham). Chris Kavanagh doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
48' Divock Origi (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is replaced by Anthony Elanga.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a short corner kick.
45+2' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
45' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.
42' Felipe (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
37' Neco Williams (Nottingham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Divock Origi (Nottingham) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
34' Divock Origi (Nottingham) plays a one-two with Neco Williams, but the move breaks down.
33' Good clearance! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
31' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
29' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
29' Divock Origi (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
27' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
23' Divock Origi (Nottingham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
21' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner kick, but Dean Henderson reads it well and stops the effort.
21' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends it out of play.

21' Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity. Divock Origi (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
16' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared.
15' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper. The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Eberechi Eze pulls the ball back for Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the top left corner. 0:1.
9' A clumsy foul by Felipe (Nottingham) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
7' Neat passing move from Nottingham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Neco Williams (Nottingham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
